# The Wycheproof test-vector files `cargo xtask test-wycheproof` fetches, from
# https://github.com/C2SP/wycheproof (Apache-2.0) at the commit below, into target/testdata/.
# Each is checked against its SHA-256 here before use. They're the symmetric suites the
# default provider implements; the runner's table (xtask/src/test_wycheproof.rs) maps each to
# its operation. To move to a newer commit, fetch the files there and rewrite the checksums.
